verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official `@cursor/sdk` TypeScript package. It lets you call the same agent that runs in the IDE, CLI, and web app from your own code, with Local and Cloud runtimes, user or service-account API key auth, and a Cookbook of end-to-end examples. The API overview also lists TypeScript and Python SDKs for all users, and the live llms.txt index includes an SDK section. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDK works as documented, and in-depth documentation of the Python SDK and SDK Bridge beyond passing mentions.
